[Section] Languages
[source_id=23] We experimented with English INLINEFORM0 Hindi translation as the parent task. English is the assisting source language. Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi, Malayalam and Tamil are the primary source languages, and translation from these to Hindi constitute the child tasks. Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati and Marathi are Indo-Aryan languages, while Malayalam and Tamil are Dravidian languages. All these languages have a canonical SOV word order.
